_comment: The Skills roster for the Context page's Skills sub-tab.
Every entry is a real, openly-licensed Agent Skill fetched from a public
/api/documents with source_system='business_skill' so they show up under
the right business and become searchable by search_business_knowledge.
`scope` is a businesses.slug, or 'all' for a global skill every business sees.

skills.title: Farm Enterprise Finance
skills.why: Per-enterprise gross margins and cash flow for a 128-acre mixed farm — the shape AFK's KES reporting needs.

skills.title: Farm Labour Planning
skills.why: AFK runs ~54 staff in Loitokitok; this covers crew sizing, seasonal peaks, and task allocation.

skills.title: Crop Calendar & Rotation
skills.why: Rotation, succession planting and a 12-month calendar to plan against the Kenyan rain seasons.

skills.title: Rent Roll & T-12 Normalizer
skills.why: Turns a messy rent roll into an honest occupancy and NOI picture across the seven properties.

skills.title: Rental Property Bookkeeping
skills.why: Per-property income and expense tracking — the ledger layer under the rent roll.

skills.title: Receivables Aging
skills.why: Ages unpaid rent into buckets and drives the chase list — including related-party tenants.

skills.title: Zoning & Entitlement Decoder
skills.why: Decodes a Minneapolis zoning code into a buildable envelope and the entitlement path to get there.

skills.title: Entitlement & Permit Monitor
skills.why: Tracks permits across the portfolio, traces the critical path, and flags slippage.

skills.title: Cash Flow Forecast
skills.why: Forward cash view on a three-property portfolio where one vacancy moves the whole month.

skills.title: Off-Market Deal Sourcing
skills.why: Builds ranked prospect lists from public records — the top of GAKC's Kenya acquisition funnel.

skills.title: Developer Feasibility
skills.why: Ground-up feasibility: costs, returns, take-out test and what the land is actually worth.

skills.title: Multi-Entity Separation
skills.why: Keeps a Kenya entity's books cleanly separate from the US entities — the rule Hermes must never break.

skills.title: Competitor Analysis
skills.why: Structured competitive teardown — pairs with the review-intelligence work already done on rival hammams.

skills.title: Pricing Strategy
skills.why: Service and package pricing for a pre-revenue spa that has to set its card before opening.

skills.title: Launch Playbook
skills.why: Nour Hammam is pre-formation and mid-buildout at 720 E Lake — this is the go-to-market sequence.

skills.title: Net Worth Statement
skills.why: Rolls personal assets and liabilities into one statement, separate from every business ledger.

skills.title: Insurance Audit
skills.why: Coverage-gap review across personal, family and father's-care policies.

skills.title: Subscription Audit
skills.why: Finds recurring charges that have quietly outlived their use.

skills.title: Deep Research
skills.why: Eight-phase research pipeline with source-credibility scoring and citation verification — the deep-research skill, available to every business.

skills.title: Month-End Close
skills.why: One close checklist that works the same way for whichever entity is being closed.

skills.title: Monthly Digest
skills.why: The recurring what-changed-this-month summary, in the scannable shape Gandi reads best.
